# Melbourne Photobooth Hire

> Photobooth hire for weddings, corporate events, birthdays and private celebrations across Melbourne and Victoria. Enquiry-based hire with packages, gallery, FAQs and contact details on this site.

- Brand: Melbourne Photobooth Hire

## Notes

- Public page copy, services, packages, gallery images and FAQs are CMS-managed and rendered as crawlable HTML.
- Canonical host is www. The non-www host redirects to www.
- Admin (`/admin/`) and API (`/api/`) paths are not public content and are disallowed in robots.txt.
- For availability and quotes, use the enquiry form on the contact page.
